analyst_view.overall: Moreirense (9th, 14 points) host Santa Clara (4th, 21 points) on matchday 12, both coming off league defeats before the international break (Moreirense 0-1 at Sporting, Santa Clara 1-2 at home to Gil Vicente). Santa Clara's defence is badly depleted: Pedro Pacheco and Emanuel Moreira are suspended (the numbers already count both), left-back Guilherme Romão is injured, and one preview also lists Pedro Ferreira and Tiago Ferreira as injured, leaving Lucas Soares as the only available first-choice defender; A Bola expects Henrique Silva to partner 22-year-old Ythallo, who would be making his first-team debut. Moreirense, under Vasco Botelho da Costa, have Tiago Andrade fit again and Parsemain close to a return, but have the weakest defence in the top half (18 conceded). No referee has been named. The view leans a little higher on Moreirense's chances and shooting because of Santa Clara's extra absences the numbers don't list.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals and already add about 6% to Moreirense for each of the two suspended Santa Clara defenders, Pacheco and Moreira. I go a little higher, to about 2.2, because Romão is also injured and one preview says the Ferreiras are out too, so Santa Clara field an untested centre-back pair including a debutant; I keep it mild because only one outlet lists all the injuries and Santa Clara had the best defence in the top five (8 conceded).

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners, split almost evenly, and already trim both sides for low recent corner counts (Moreirense 17 and Santa Clara 19 in their last six). A makeshift Santa Clara back line might concede a few more set pieces, but Moreirense have not been winning many corners lately, so nothing points clearly either way and I stay at 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, already adding about 6% for Santa Clara's 22 cards in their last six and trimming Moreirense for only 9. Inexperienced Santa Clara defenders could be drawn into fouls, but that is a hunch, the previous meetings were tight rather than bad-tempered, and no referee has been named, so I stay at 5.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.6 shots, already adding about 7% to Moreirense and 6% to Santa Clara for recent shooting and defending. I add a little more, to about 23.3, because the preview expects Moreirense to attack the improvised Santa Clara defence early, and the injured defenders beyond the two suspensions are not in the numbers.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.4 shots on target, trimmed for both sides' modest recent accuracy. With Santa Clara missing up to five regular defenders and starting a debutant at centre-back, Moreirense should get some clearer chances than usual, so I go up mildly to about 6.7; the two suspensions are already counted, so this covers only the injuries.
